description: Phase 6 catalog evaluation cases for five competition change domains. All cases use Sentinel-2-era dates (>= 2015-06-23). Ground truth is not claimed unless explicitly noted.

cases.title: Bengaluru eastern growth corridor
cases.query: Show urban expansion between these dates in this AOI.
cases.expected_change: Built-up expansion and impervious surface increase in Bengaluru's eastern periphery.
cases.reference: Documented metropolitan growth in Bengaluru; qualitative visual assessment against Sentinel-2 anchor scenes.
cases.notes: Urban monthly Sentinel-2 benchmark (Zenodo) covers similar land-cover classes but is not wired as polygon GT here.

cases.title: Amazon deforestation frontier (Rondônia)
cases.query: Show deforestation and vegetation loss in this AOI.
cases.expected_change: Forest clearing and vegetation loss patches along agricultural frontier.
cases.reference: Amazon deforestation monitoring context (INPE PRODES); qualitative only — seasonality risk in dry-season pair.
cases.notes: Dry-season pairing reduces but does not eliminate phenology false positives.

cases.title: Lake Mead water extent reduction
cases.query: Show areas where the water body shrank in this AOI.
cases.expected_change: Reduced open-water extent along Lake Mead shoreline (documented drought period).
cases.reference: US Bureau of Reclamation Lake Mead bathymetry/elevation records; qualitative shoreline change.
cases.notes: Seasonal inflow variation remains a false-positive risk even with same-month pairing.

cases.title: Dubai south infrastructure growth
cases.query: Highlight possible infrastructure development in this AOI.
cases.expected_change: New transport and built infrastructure in Dubai south / Expo corridor.
cases.reference: Documented infrastructure expansion in Dubai south; system reports built/spectral candidates only.
cases.notes: Cannot distinguish roads, ports, and general built-up without asset maps.

cases.title: Open-pit mining disturbance (EU reference context)
cases.query: Find areas of land disturbance consistent with mining in this AOI.
cases.expected_change: Surface disturbance near documented European open-cast mining activity.
cases.reference: EuroMineNet multitemporal mining footprint benchmark (EU, Sentinel-2 2015–2024).
cases.notes: EuroMineNet provides expert annotations but is not imported as GT in this phase; mining claims remain conservative.
